purpose: Bind Defence GitHub OIDC trust to immutable repository and owner identities in addition to mutable repository names.
subjectRule: Exact GitHub legacy repository-ref subject or exact GitHub immutable repository-ref subject only.
dynamicBinding: Release-head and rollback consumers compare signed repository_id and repository_owner_id against Foundation target metadata.
fixedBinding: Core provider, re-attestation and deployment-receipt consumers pin the Core repository ID and owner ID directly in OIDC policy.
invariants: A repository rename cannot silently rebind Defence trust.
A deleted and recreated repository with the same owner/name does not inherit the old repository identity.
A repository transferred away from the pinned owner identity fails closed.
Self-hosted runner tokens are rejected by current Defence ingestion paths.
workflow_sha is preserved from GitHub's signed workflow_sha claim.
Legacy and immutable GitHub subject formats are accepted only when every embedded name/id/ref matches the signed claims.
